_readme: Copy to config.json (or any name, then --config) and edit. The two request bodies are sent as they are, except for these placeholders the script fills in: {timestamp}, {projectId}, {versionId}, {versionTag}. Keys starting with _ are comments. See README.md.

server._database: postgresql or sqlite -- the server's database. With sqlite, two saves at the same moment are only reported (WARN): SQLite has no per-version save lock.

onboard._project_id: Leave empty to create a new project from create_project. Set it to test an existing project.
onboard._create_project: The body of POST /api/v1/projects -- what the web app's New Project wizard sends. repo_url must be a git repository the SERVER can clone: a URL (with access_token if private) or a path on the server's machine. For the sample, run: python tools/review_api_test/review_api_test.py --make-sample-repo C:/work/sample-repo

generate._version_id: Leave empty to generate a version with start_job. Set it (with onboard.project_id) to test an existing version -- the corrections this test makes stay on it.
generate._start_job: The body of POST /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/jobs. commit_sha 'latest' = the newest commit the server lists for the project. version_tag must be new in the project, hence {timestamp}. no_llm true runs in minutes; the LLM wording is then empty for most slots, which the test handles.

test._kinds: The slot kinds to correct. All seven by default.
test._carry_forward: Generates one more version from the tested one (same commit) and checks every correction is carried into it.
